product.description: ZER0 (Zer0.ai) helps apparel brands, retailers with private label, and importers that source directly find factory partners who can take small-to-mid programmes with real capacity — especially when sustainability, materials, or compliance is part of the buy. Not a marketplace; not agent-locked sourcing. Canadian entity; outreach is draft-only until human approve.
